title.en: Printed-row question: This is masonry, blockwork or a render coat. The material is mortar or a fine coat, not a structural stone pipeline — Type 311. The hose is 25 mm and the particle is ≤2 mm.
title.zh: 先看已印出的行：这是砌体、砌块或罩面。材料是砂浆或薄涂层，不是结构石子管路：311型。管径是 25 mm，粒径是 ≤2 mm。

description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. This is masonry, blockwork or a render coat. Read it in the Xingtai table. The material is mortar or a fine coat, not a structural stone pipeline. Taken from the printed row: The hose is 25 mm and the particle is ≤2 mm. Keep this cell as published. That is a mortar spray, not an 80 mm concrete pipeline. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists Type 311 at 220/380 V, 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 15 m horizontal / 5 m vertical, hose 25 mm, particle ≤2 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 420 × 900 mm and 150 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not move the same condition onto Electric 20, which prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, 120 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm and 900 kg. Taken from the printed row: The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. Keep this cell as published. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This note names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
description.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。这是砌体、砌块或罩面。材料是砂浆或薄涂层，不是结构石子管路。管径是 25 mm，粒径是 ≤2 mm。这是砂浆喷涂，不是 80 mm 的混凝土管路。邢台河北品锦机械把311型列为220/380V、4 kW、2 m³/h、3–5 MPa、水平 15 m / 垂直 5 m、管径 25 mm、粒径 ≤2 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、外形 1500 × 420 × 900 mm、150 kg。不要把同一工况挪到电动20，那一行印的是22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、水平 120 m / 垂直 40 m、管内径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm、料斗 0.25 m³、外形 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm、900 kg。这张照片来自一篇公开文章，只作这类工况的参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
